{{for|others with the same surname|Ayellin}}
'''Dav Ayellin''' is a young man from the [[Two Rivers]].  While growing up in [[Emond's Field]] he was close friends with [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat Cauthon]].  He and Mat sometimes competed to see who could get in the most trouble, unless they worked together to cause it.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Dav Ayellin}}  Dav also spent time hunting and fishing with [[Elam Dowtry]] and [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Appearance==
He is short young man with a build that is stockier than Mat.{{ref/book|4|43}}  Like Mat, he frequently has a rumpled, uncombed look about him and often displays a twinkle of mischief in his eyes.{{ref/book|4|43}}  

== Activities ==
On the day before [[Bel Tine]] in {{ne|998}}, Dav partnered with Mat to drag a badger out of its den with plans to release it on the village [[Green]] while the [[Spring Pole]] was being erected.{{ref/book|1|1}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Dav Ayellin}}  The goal was to startle the young girls who were watching the older women erect the pole.  The prank was not completed because Mat became distracted while talking to his friend [[Rand al'Thor]] about a [[Moiraine Damodred|mysterious visitor]] to the village and her [[Al'Lan Mandragoran|male companion]]. 

The next year in 999NE Dav became one of the early followers of Perrin who had returned to the [[Two Rivers]] with [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|Faile Bashere]].  Dav helped to carry Perrin into the [[Winespring Inn]] after the Waterwood Skirmish.  Though only slightly younger than Perrin, Dav's thrilled grin leads Perrin to mark him as inexperienced and slightly naive.{{ref/book|4|43}} Later Dav participates in the [[Battle of Emond's Field]] where he helps defend the north perimeter of the village.{{ref/book|4|56}}

In the fall of 999NE Dav runs away from the [[Two Rivers]] with [[Elam Dowtry]] and [[Ewin Finngar]] to explore the world.{{ref/book|6|p}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Dav Ayellin}}
